# Kleos Research

> Kleos is an AI research lab working on agent harnesses, local memory across tools, and measurement of what an agent actually costs.

## Products

- [Kaleidoscope](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/): Local memory for AI agents through a CLI and stdio MCP. It installs from npm on macOS and Linux and needs a key to run.
- [Kaleidoscope getting started](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/getting-started/): Install from npm, activate your key, and give a project a memory.
- [Kaleidoscope integrations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/integrations/): Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, and generic MCP.
- [Kaleidoscope install](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/packages/): The npm package, what it puts on your disk, and what your machine needs. There is no Python package.
- [Kaleidoscope licenses and terms](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/legal/): Apache-2.0 public software boundary, CC BY 4.0 documentation, and review-draft engine terms.
- [0xCopilot](https://copilot.kleosresearch.xyz/): Local-first desktop agent.

## Lab

- [Research](https://kleosresearch.xyz/research/): Papers, reports, specifications, and protocols.
- [Products](https://kleosresearch.xyz/products/): Product overview and the Kaleidoscope install command.
- [About](https://kleosresearch.xyz/lab/): How Kleos Research works.
